# SpexSol

> SpexSol s. r. o. is a small software studio in Slovakia (Bojničky). It builds web and mobile products, automation, AI integrations and does code audits for clients in Slovakia and abroad. Engagements are monthly retainers or fixed-price projects. Site is in English (/en) and Slovak (/sk).

Contact: skalicky@spexsol.sk. Replies within one business day.
Company ID (IČO): 57004196. VAT ID (DIČ): 2122528089.

## Pages

- [Home](https://spexsol.sk/en): services, offer, FAQ, contact form
- [Products & partnerships](https://spexsol.sk/en/products): apps and websites built, past collaborations
- [Case studies](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies): concept case studies showing problem framing and solution design
  - [FieldFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/fieldflow): concept (not a delivered product) for turning photographed field service reports into structured, human-reviewed records with AI-assisted extraction. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
  - [InvoiceFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/invoiceflow): concept (not a delivered product) for collecting supplier invoices in one place, extracting key fields with AI assistance and routing them through human approval. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
  - [QuoteFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/quoteflow): concept (not a delivered product) for building B2B quotes from templates with agreed pricing rules, manager approval of exceptions and versioned proposals. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
  - [ShiftFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/shiftflow): concept (not a delivered product) for replacing chat-based timesheets with mobile shift reporting, supervisor review and a payroll-ready export. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
  - [StockFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/stockflow): concept (not a delivered product) for capturing stock movements by scanning, validating quantity and location, and sharing a current inventory view. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
  - [FixFlow](https://spexsol.sk/en/case-studies/fixflow): concept (not a delivered product) for turning maintenance calls and emails into tracked requests with a clear owner, updates and coordinator review. Status: Concept / Planned MVP. No client, no measured results.
- [Contact](https://spexsol.sk/en/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://spexsol.sk/en/privacy-policy): covers website and SpexSol mobile apps
